notes.title: Get the full EVERGATE experience for just $9.99!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

We hope you've been enjoying [i][b]Evergate: Ki's Awakening[/b][/i] and been able to experience the Soulflame mechanic, the power of the crystals and just a few of the puzzles that Evergate has to offer. 

We're delighted to share that you can now experience the full [b]Evergate[/b] game for $9.99 on Steam, starting today! Check out the Steam page for pricing in your country: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/845030/Evergate/

- PQube & Stone Lantern Games
